findings.title: Persistent notification intercepts Chat Send
findings.trigger: Save a manual meal, switch to Chat, type and click Send without dismissing saved notice
findings.actual: Send center hit-tests to Dismiss notification and normal pointer click fails; dismissing notice permits Send
findings.impact: Recoverable extra action blocks a central workflow
findings.suggestedRemedy: Keep notifications clear of composer actions and define dismissal/expiry behavior

findings.title: Older manual meals cannot be retrieved through native diary
findings.trigger: Save a meal dated August31 while current day is September30
findings.actual: Meal persists and exports, but selectable diary days are September24–30. You/review/chat/pantry supply no alternate full food archive or manual meal editor
findings.impact: Ordinary history eventually cannot be corrected, repeated or deleted through the app
findings.suggestedRemedy: Expose arbitrary day selection or searchable full history and a post-save link to chosen date

findings.title: Workout detail and correction history stops after twelve sessions
findings.trigger: Start, log and finish thirteen sessions
findings.actual: Thirteen sessions are persisted; only twelve correction cards render, without pagination/full history
findings.impact: Returning users lose UI access to older set details/corrections even though data remains
findings.suggestedRemedy: Keep recent summary but provide all history

findings.title: Guest backup tool promises automatic account saving
findings.trigger: Fresh guest without server/account opens Cloud & your records
findings.actual: Unconditional account saves automatically copy appears above missing-server instruction
findings.impact: User can misunderstand recovery and cross-device availability
findings.suggestedRemedy: Render storage/sync status from actual connection/account state

findings.title: Invalid backup exposes raw parser error
findings.trigger: Select malformed synthetic JSON via Import a backup file
findings.actual: Records remain unchanged and restore is unavailable, but raw syntax error is displayed
findings.impact: Recovery explanation is technical and lacks a next step
findings.suggestedRemedy: Explain invalid backup and invite another file with optional technical detail

wishes.title: Explicit calories-only meal with unknown macros

wishes.recurringImportance: Potentially frequent for users with calorie-only labels; must preserve unknown versus zero semantics
